message.content:
**Research findings**

- Apple's press release (Q4 FY2024, quarter ended Sept 28, 2024): quarterly revenue $94.9B, +6% YoY; **fiscal 2024 total net sales $391.0 billion**; net income $93.7B, or $6.08 diluted EPS, including a one-time $10.2B tax charge.
- Cross-checked with the FY2024 Form 10-K on SEC EDGAR: total net sales **$391,035 million** (vs. $383,285M in FY2023), net income $93,736M, diluted EPS $6.08, operating income $123,216M.
- Quote at time of trade: AAPL $222.70 last (bid/ask 222.68/222.72).

**Order placed:** Buy 44 AAPL @ limit $222.80 (filled at $222.80, ~$9,803 total).

**Summary:** I researched Apple's latest reported results, confirming from both Apple's Q4 FY2024 press release and the FY2024 10-K that fiscal 2024 total net sales were $391.0 billion (precisely $391,035 million), up from $383,285 million in FY2023, with net income of $93.7 billion ($93,736M) and diluted EPS of $6.08 — a figure that absorbed a one-time $10.2 billion tax charge, with operating income of $123.2 billion and Q4 revenue up 6% YoY to $94.9 billion, indicating healthy underlying demand and record annual revenue. With AAPL trading at $222.70 (bid 222.68 / ask 222.72), I judged the growth and cash generation supportive of adding to the position, and bought 44 shares with a limit at $222.80 — right at the ask, well within the mandate: a buy order, ~$9,803 which is under the $10,000 per-order cap and the $20,000 daily cap, AAPL being an approved name, and no funds moved out of the account (cash was $50,000, existing holdings 100 MSFT). The order filled at $222.80.

Order filled: 44 × 222.80 = $9,803.20. Under $10,000 per order, within $20,000 total. No transfers.
